relevance_note: One in-scope child (P6) has a 6q23.3-q24.1 deletion that removes TNFAIP3 ("The TNFAIP3 gene was involved in the deleted fragment in P6"), and the literature table includes a previously published patient with a 6q23.2-q24.3 deletion described in reference [18] as "TNFAIP3 haploinsufficiency".
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema (schema_ha20_v5.json), the rules and extract_v6.md; no script was used, every span was copied by hand from the Markdown and re-checked. Scope (D-22): the paper is a FUO/chromosomal-abnormality cohort, so only people with a TNFAIP3 involvement are in scope - P6 (3.576 Mb deletion at 6q23.3-q24.1 including TNFAIP3) and the single literature-review patient from reference [18] (6q23.2-q24.3 del; reference title states "TNFAIP3 haploinsufficiency is the cause of autoinflammatory manifestations in a patient with a deletion of 13Mb on chromosome 6"). The other 7 cohort patients (P1-P5, P7, P8) and the other 18 literature-review patients have chromosomal abnormalities involving other genes and get no rows; they are counted in publications.cohort_size_as_stated (145). Table 1 and Table 2 have patients as columns in the order P1-P8, with a Reference range column; Table 3 has patients as rows, so labels follow rule 3 ("Table 3 row 1" is the first data row, 6q23.2-q24.3 del). Symbols: the table notes define only NA/ND and the abbreviations; "-"/"-" is not defined as absent, so those cells were recorded as not reported, while "+" was read as present (Table 3 has no legend for "+"). Table 3 has stacked cells in the first column (the "Trisomy 8" and "15q del" cells are blank in later rows) and one cell of Table 1 reads "Oral aphthousperianal abscess" for P4, while the text attributes "perianal, colon and intestinal ulcers" to P5: that attribution is ambiguous, so no perianal-abscess feature was emitted for anyone (P4/P5 are out of scope in any case). publications.n_patients_reported is null because the authors never state a number of TNFAIP3-variant patients; cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is false with span null because no such statement exists (the literature-review patients are other authors' patients, recorded in source_reference_in_review). genomic_coordinates_as_stated is null for both variants because only cytobands are printed. The parents of the cohort patients ("Their parents had no FUO, and no chromosomal abnormalities were detected."; Fig. 4 legend "Father (orange), mother (gray), P6 (blue)") are described only as a group and were not given rows; this is the main judgement call. HPO identifiers were left null (labels only).

In patients with inflammatory fever, we identified de novo CNVs: a 7q11.23 duplication in P1; a deletion at 3p26.3-p26.1 and a duplication at 17q12 in P2; a 0.7 Mb deletion at 22q11.21 (20,733,478–21,461,788) without involvement of the TBX1 gene in P3; and a 3.576 Mb deletion at 6q23.3-q24.1 in P6 (Fig. 4a).
